description: Power/UPS, cooling/CRAC, and environmental monitoring — battery health, thermal management, and physical security.
name: Data Center Physical Infrastructure
quickFacts: Integrate DCIM or BMS platforms via SNMP or API to collect environmental and power data.

useCases.title: UPS Battery Health
useCases.value: UPS battery degradation is the single largest cause of unprotected power events. Proactive replacement prevents data center outages.

useCases.title: PDU Power per Rack
useCases.value: Per-rack power monitoring prevents circuit overloads and enables efficient rack placement for new equipment.

useCases.title: Power Redundancy Status
useCases.value: Loss of A/B feed redundancy means a single power failure will cause an outage. Immediate awareness enables emergency response.

useCases.title: Generator Test Results
useCases.value: Generators are the last line of defense during extended outages. Failed tests mean they may not start when needed.

useCases.title: PUE Calculation
useCases.value: Power Usage Effectiveness is the primary data center efficiency metric. Trending drives energy optimization and sustainability goals.

useCases.title: Circuit Breaker Trips
useCases.value: Breaker trips cause immediate power loss to affected equipment. Detection enables rapid response and root cause investigation.

useCases.title: APC PDU Outlet-Level Power Monitoring
useCases.value: Per-outlet current draw and on/off state on APC rack PDUs enables granular power attribution, remote outlet control verification, and identification of high-draw devices within a rack.

useCases.title: Generator Runtime and Fuel Level
useCases.value: Diesel generator monitoring for extended outages; fuel level and run hours ensure generators can sustain operations during prolonged utility failures.

useCases.title: Rack Power Density Trending
useCases.value: Watts per rack unit over time for capacity planning; identifies hot spots and supports safe equipment placement decisions.

useCases.title: UPS Battery Runtime Remaining
useCases.value: Minutes of runtime remaining under present load is the actionable metric for graceful shutdown sequencing during outages.

useCases.title: PDU Outlet-Level Power Draw
useCases.value: Per-outlet amps identify rogue devices and balance load across strips before branch trips.

useCases.title: Generator Fuel Level Monitoring
useCases.value: Tank level and burn rate determine how long the site can run off-grid; critical for extended utility failures.

useCases.title: Transfer Switch Events
useCases.value: ATS transitions between utility and generator must be logged for root cause of brief outages and equipment stress.

useCases.title: Power Factor Monitoring
useCases.value: Low PF increases utility demand charges and heats conductors; correction banks need verification.

useCases.title: PUE Efficiency Tracking vs Target
useCases.value: Comparing live PUE to annual design target drives mechanical optimization and executive reporting.

useCases.title: Breaker Panel Load Balancing
useCases.value: Uneven loading across panel phases causes neutral current and premature breaker wear.

useCases.title: UPS Self-Test Failure
useCases.value: Failed self-tests indicate battery or inverter faults before a real outage.

useCases.title: Generator Start Failure
useCases.value: Failed cranks or inability to reach rated speed leave the site on battery-only until resolved.

useCases.title: Power Redundancy Compliance (N+1)
useCases.value: Proves both A/B feeds and redundant UPS paths are energized and within load limits for loss-of-one scenarios.

useCases.title: PDU Branch Circuit Alerts
useCases.value: Branch breakers trip before mains; per-branch monitoring catches overload before rack outage.

useCases.title: Electrical Panel Phase Balancing
useCases.value: Panel-level phase balance differs from rack PDU balance; both matter for neutral harmonics and breaker life.

useCases.title: UPS Battery Monitoring
useCases.value: UPS battery failure during power loss causes complete outage. Proactive monitoring prevents unprotected power events.

useCases.title: Power Consumption Trending
useCases.value: Power consumption trending supports capacity planning, cost management, and sustainability reporting. Anomalies indicate equipment issues.

useCases.title: Rack PDU Load and Phase Balance
useCases.value: PDU overload or phase imbalance risks circuit trips and equipment failure. Monitoring supports capacity planning and safe load distribution.

useCases.title: Generator Run Hours and Maintenance Due
useCases.value: Generator maintenance based on run hours ensures reliability during outages. Tracking run hours and maintenance due dates avoids missed service.

useCases.title: Temperature Monitoring per Zone
useCases.value: Data center temperature exceedances risk equipment damage and unplanned shutdowns. Per-zone monitoring localizes issues.

useCases.title: Humidity Monitoring
useCases.value: Low humidity causes ESD risk; high humidity causes condensation. Maintaining 40-60% RH protects equipment.

useCases.title: CRAC/CRAH Unit Health
useCases.value: Cooling unit failures can cause rapid temperature rise. Monitoring operational status enables immediate response and failover.

useCases.title: Hot Aisle Temperature Trending
useCases.value: Hot aisle trends indicate cooling efficiency and capacity margin. Rising trends signal approaching cooling limits.

useCases.title: Water Leak Detection
useCases.value: Water in a data center causes immediate equipment damage and potential electrical hazards. Seconds matter in detection.

useCases.title: Cooling Capacity Planning
useCases.value: Trending cooling load vs capacity ensures adequate cooling for current and planned equipment deployments.

useCases.title: APC InRow / CRAC Unit Temperature Differential
useCases.value: Inlet/outlet delta-T indicating cooling effectiveness; low delta-T suggests bypass airflow or undersized cooling; high delta-T indicates effective heat removal.

useCases.title: CRAC Unit Failure and Alarm State
useCases.value: Explicit CRAC fault/alarm bits catch compressor and fan failures not visible in temperature alone.

useCases.title: Hot/Cold Aisle Temperature Delta
useCases.value: Low ΔT across containment indicates bypass airflow or insufficient airflow; high ΔT may signal restricted return.

useCases.title: Humidity Threshold Exceedance (ASHRAE)
useCases.value: Stricter alerting for short excursions supports tape media and corrosion-sensitive gear beyond static high/low limits.

useCases.title: Chiller Plant Efficiency (kW/ton)
useCases.value: Elevated kW/ton indicates fouling, low refrigerant, or poor tower performance.

useCases.title: Liquid Cooling Loop Pressure
useCases.value: Leak or pump failure shows first as pressure loss or delta-P across strainers.

useCases.title: Air Handler Filter Differential Pressure
useCases.value: High ΔP across filters increases fan energy and reduces airflow; indicates change-out due.

useCases.title: Cooling Capacity vs IT Load
useCases.value: Compares available tons to IT heat load (from power meters) to expose margin before next summer.

useCases.title: Economizer Mode Utilization
useCases.value: Low economizer hours may indicate stuck dampers or bad enthalpy programming—wasting energy.

useCases.title: Condensation Risk Alerts
useCases.value: Surface temp below dew point risks water on equipment and slip hazards near chilled doors.

useCases.title: Cooling Redundancy Status
useCases.value: N+1 cooling requires knowing when one CRAC is down and remaining capacity still covers peak IT load.

useCases.title: Data Center Humidity & Condensation Risk
useCases.value: Prevents equipment failure by detecting dew point conditions before condensation forms on servers and network infrastructure.

useCases.title: Water Leak Sensor Zone Correlation
useCases.value: Correlates multiple rope sensors to localize leak source and trigger EPO workflows under raised floor.

useCases.title: Badge Access Audit
useCases.value: Complete badge access audit trail is required for compliance (SOC2, PCI-DSS) and supports security investigations.

useCases.title: After-Hours Access Alerts
useCases.value: Data center access outside business hours requires additional scrutiny. Alerts ensure authorized personnel are verified.

useCases.title: Tailgating Detection
useCases.value: Tailgating bypasses access control, allowing unauthorized entry. Detection supports physical security integrity.

useCases.title: Camera System Health
useCases.value: Offline cameras create security blind spots. Monitoring ensures continuous surveillance coverage.

useCases.title: Cabinet Door Monitoring
useCases.value: Unauthorized cabinet access could indicate tampering. Door sensors provide granular physical security for critical racks.

useCases.title: Fire Suppression and Detection System Alarms
useCases.value: Fire and gas detection events require immediate response. Centralized alarm monitoring ensures rapid escalation and audit trail.

useCases.title: Raised Floor and Cable Management Events
useCases.value: Floor tile removal or cable strain events can indicate unauthorized work or trip hazards. Monitoring supports physical security and change audit.

useCases.title: Data Center Capacity Headroom by Zone
useCases.value: Tracking power, cooling, and space headroom by zone supports capacity planning and prevents over-provisioning in hot spots.

useCases.title: CCTV / IP Camera Health Monitoring
useCases.value: Camera online/offline, storage utilization, recording status ensures continuous surveillance coverage and prevents blind spots during security incidents.

useCases.title: Fire Suppression System Status
useCases.value: Pre-action system armed/disarmed, agent levels (FM-200/Novec) ensure fire suppression readiness; disarmed or low-agent systems leave the data center unprotected.

useCases.title: Environmental Sensor Battery Status
useCases.value: Wireless environmental sensor battery health; dead batteries create monitoring gaps and risk undetected temperature or humidity exceedances.

useCases.title: Badge Tailgating and Anti-Passback Violations
useCases.value: Tracks piggyback events where anti-passback rules fire or two entries occur without intermediate exit—stronger signal than generic door events alone.

useCases.title: After-Hours Access Without Active Work Order
useCases.value: Correlates physical entry with ITSM change/work order to catch unauthorized after-hours presence.

useCases.title: Camera Feed Loss and Recording Gap Detection
useCases.value: Detects loss of RTSP/HLS stream and gaps in NVR recording separately from generic camera “offline” pings.

useCases.title: Visitor Badge Expiry Tracking
useCases.value: Expired visitor badges that remain active create audit findings and tailgating risk.

useCases.title: Cabinet Intrusion and Forced Rack Door Events
useCases.value: Lateral contact/forced-open sensors on colo cabinets detect physical tampering faster than walk-through audits.

useCases.title: Fire Suppression System Health and Supervisory Signals
useCases.value: Supervisory off-normal (low air, pre-action valve trouble) precedes full alarm; distinct from agent level alone.

useCases.title: Access Control Panel Tamper and Line Fault
useCases.value: Enclosure tamper, RS-485 ground faults, or DC line faults may precede bypass or sabotage.

useCases.title: Camera Uptime and Availability Tracking (Meraki MV)
useCases.value: Monitors video surveillance system availability to ensure continuous monitoring coverage.

useCases.title: Video Retention and Cloud Archive Storage Utilization (Meraki MV)
useCases.value: Tracks cloud storage usage for video archives to manage costs and ensure retention SLA.

useCases.title: Motion Detection Events and Alert Volume Analysis (Meraki MV)
useCases.value: Analyzes motion detection event patterns to optimize camera sensitivity and reduce false alerts.

useCases.title: Camera Video Quality Score and Stream Health (Meraki MV)
useCases.value: Monitors video quality metrics to identify network or hardware issues affecting video feeds.

useCases.title: Cloud Archive Status and Backup Validation (Meraki MV)
useCases.value: Ensures video archives are successfully uploaded to cloud and backup integrity is maintained.

useCases.title: Video Stream Connection Errors and Quality Issues (Meraki MV)
useCases.value: Detects video stream connection failures that prevent remote viewing or recording.

useCases.title: Camera Firmware Compliance and Update Management (Meraki MV)
useCases.value: Ensures all cameras run current firmware with security patches.

useCases.title: Night Mode Effectiveness and Low-Light Performance (Meraki MV)
useCases.value: Monitors camera performance in low-light conditions to ensure night surveillance effectiveness.

useCases.title: People Counting Trends and Occupancy Analytics
useCases.value: Uses camera people counting to track foot traffic trends for space utilization and facility planning.

useCases.title: Building Occupancy Trending and Capacity Planning
useCases.value: Provides real-time and historical people counts per building, floor, and zone using data from Meraki APs and cameras. Supports compliance with fire safety capacity limits, energy management optimizat…

useCases.title: Visitor Dwell Time and Movement Flow Analysis
useCases.value: Measures how long visitors and employees spend in specific zones and tracks movement patterns between areas. For corporate campuses, this optimizes cafeteria layouts, identifies bottleneck corridors,…

useCases.title: Environmental Sensor Monitoring (Temperature, Humidity, Air Quality)
useCases.value: Monitors environmental conditions using Meraki MT sensors — temperature, humidity, air quality (PM2.5, TVOC, CO2), and water leaks. Protects server rooms and network closets from overheating, monitor…

useCases.title: Asset Tracking and Geofencing Alerts
useCases.value: Tracks the real-time location of high-value assets (medical equipment, network gear, tools, laptops, carts) using BLE tags and Cisco Spaces IoT Explorer. Geofencing alerts notify when assets leave de…

useCases.title: After-Hours Wireless Presence Detection
useCases.value: Detects Wi-Fi-connected devices present in buildings or restricted zones outside of business hours. Correlates with badge access data and employee schedules to identify unauthorized presence — potent…

useCases.title: Workspace Utilization and Ghost Booking Detection
useCases.value: Combines room booking data with actual physical occupancy from Cisco Spaces and Webex device sensors to calculate true workspace utilization. Identifies "ghost bookings" — rooms reserved but never oc…

useCases.title: Access Control Event Audit
useCases.value: Physical access logs correlate with logical access events for security investigation. Audit trail required for compliance.

useCases.title: Cisco Spaces Wayfinding and Path Analytics
useCases.value: Understanding how people physically move through a building reveals traffic bottlenecks, dead zones, and inefficient layouts invisible to static occupancy sensors. Cisco Spaces path analytics tracks…

useCases.title: Cisco Spaces Proximity and Engagement Analytics
useCases.value: For corporate campuses, retail environments, and visitor centers, understanding how people engage with specific zones — reception desks, demo areas, retail displays, cafeterias, wellness rooms — tran…
